clips.title: The story
paras: Lonebrow's Journal is an Alliance quest initiated by finding a weathered book held in the hand of a dead dwarf at the base of the Great Lift in Thousand Needles. The notes detail his final journey and prompt the finder to deliver the volume west to a night elf druid stationed on the Feralas border.

Near the base of the Great Lift, the massive mechanical elevator connecting the Barrens to the canyon floor of Thousand Needles, lies the body of Henrig Lonebrow. Clutched in his hand is a personal journal detailing his travels through this rugged territory. Left behind in a hostile desert dominated by centaur and tauren, his corpse serves as a grim warning of how unforgiving the canyon can be to isolated travelers.

Reading through Henrig's journal reveals his intended path and final wish. Rather than leaving his findings to decay in the canyon, the explorer hoped his records would reach friendly hands. Following the road straight west across Thousand Needles leads out of the dry gullies and toward Thalanaar, the night elf outpost guarding the border to Feralas, where the druid Falfindel Waywarder awaits news of the traveler.
